rules.reason: The scheduler engine changes with most fixes; a binary that links it ships with each of them. Use the leaves instead: pkg/storagekey (storage keys), pkg/nodereport (signed capacity reports and inventories), pkg/leaser (the lease contract).

gRPC links it unless the grpcnotrace tag is set (Makefile DAEMON_TAGS); its html/template pages reach reflect.Value.MethodByName, which makes the linker keep every exported method of every type converted to an interface, so every store query change rewrites the daemon (docs/adr/20261020160744-daemon-blast-radius.md).

Executing a template reaches text/template's reflect.Value.MethodByName, which makes the linker keep every exported method of every type converted to an interface: gatewayd-internal linked all 4,169 *state.PgStore methods through pkg/gateway's challenge page, so every store change rebuilt the edge lane. Write the page with html.EscapeString (pkg/gateway/edge_rules_challenge_page.go; finding 7 of docs/adr/20261020160744-daemon-blast-radius.md). net/rpc imports it for a debug page no daemon serves; apid renders its dashboard with it and links the whole store regardless.

Executing a template reaches reflect.Value.MethodByName (see the html/template rule). goose only parses its migration-file template at init and never executes it in a daemon; html/template is covered by its own rule.
